faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AI Crypto Tracker

q1.question: How does the AI trading work?
q1.answer: Our AI uses advanced machine learning models trained on years of market data. It analyzes technical indicators, market sentiment, on-chain data, and news to identify high-probability trading opportunities and execute trades automatically.

q2.question: Is my money safe?
q2.answer: Absolutely. AI Crypto Tracker never holds your funds — they stay on your exchange. We connect via read-and-trade API keys only. All connections are encrypted with bank-grade security, and we support 2FA for account protection.

q3.question: What exchanges are supported?
q3.answer: We support 150+ exchanges including Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, Bybit, OKX, KuCoin, and many more. New exchanges are added regularly based on user demand.

q4.question: What is the minimum investment?
q4.answer: There is no minimum investment required by AI Crypto Tracker. You can start trading with whatever amount you're comfortable with on your connected exchange. We recommend starting small while learning the platform.

q5.question: How accurate are the AI predictions?
q5.answer: Our AI signals have a verified accuracy rate of 94.7% based on backtesting. However, past performance doesn't guarantee future results. We recommend using proper risk management and never investing more than you can afford to lose.

q6.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
q6.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time with no hidden fees or penalties. Your access continues until the end of your billing period. We also offer a 14-day free trial on the Pro plan.

q7.question: Do I need trading experience?
q7.answer: Not at all! AI Crypto Tracker is designed for traders of all levels. Our AI handles the complex analysis, and we provide educational resources, tutorials, and 24/7 support to help you get started.

q8.question: What about fees and commissions?
q8.answer: AI Crypto Tracker charges a flat monthly subscription fee — no hidden commissions, no percentage of profits. Exchange trading fees still apply as charged by your exchange, but we optimize trade execution to minimize these costs.
